description: Rise-fall envelope generator with a VCA built in, able to cycle, to follow a voltage, or to be triggered

params.text: Picks which of three ranges the RISE slider covers: FAST, MED or SLOW
Picks which of three ranges the FALL slider covers: FAST, MED or SLOW
Sets the envelope cycling, so it turns round at the end of each fall and rises again
Sets the rise time inside the range its three-way range switch picks
Sets the fall time inside the range its three-way range switch picks
Sets the height of the ENV output, 0V to 10V
An attenuverter, -100% to +100%, setting how much the TIME CV jack moves the rise time
An attenuverter, -100% to +100%, setting how much the TIME CV jack moves the fall time

inputs.text: Moves the rise and fall times, each through its own attenuverter knob
A rising edge above 2V starts the envelope again from where it is
Above 0.5V this reverses the CYCLE button, so the envelope loops while the button is off and stops while it is on
Patching this jack puts the envelope into follow mode: instead of running to its own top it slews toward this voltage, at the rise and fall times set
The signal passing through the built-in VCA

outputs.text: The envelope, from 0V to the height the ENV LEVEL slider sets
8V for as long as the envelope is falling
The input through the VCA, its gain set by the envelope and reaching about unity at the envelope's top

notes: The envelope, the EOR output and the VCA gain follow the TRIGGER jack's channel count, and the audio path follows AUDIO IN's, both up to four channels.
